description_en: Predicts wall lines and returns a task ID and a sub-scene ID. You can query the task status by using the task ID. After the task is completed, you can query the specific wall line data by using the sub-scene ID
description_zh: 墙线预测，返回taskId以及subsceneId，可以根据taskId查询任务状态，任务结束后可以根据subsceneId查询具体墙线数据
name: PredictionWallLine

parameters.help_en: The height of the camera. Unit: cm
parameters.name: camera_height

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The diagnostic details for authentication returned when a permission check fails. The details include the authentication principal, action, policy, and reason for denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication action that triggered the permission denied error. You can use this action to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity identifier of the authentication principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An authorized account administrator can decode this message to troubleshoot the reason for denial
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the reason for the permission denied error, which distinguishes between not being explicitly authorized and being explicitly denied
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which corresponds to the requestId request parameter

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
